Compact ICC Profiles: Clinton Ingram / saucecontrol, CC0 1.0 (https://github.com/saucecontrol/Compact-ICC-Profiles). The bundled upstream ICC README lists the latter as MIT; the actual upstream license is CC0, preserved beside the files. No ICC files were changed. Our output embeds an sRGB ICC profile generated by LittleCMS through Pillow. No film simulation source or profile data was modified.
